summary: Phase B follow-up dashboard UI verified end-to-end for both counsellor (Priya) and admin. All 5 sections render with counts, Add Update dialog validations (empty discussed, missing next date for open statuses, Lost reason required, Registered/Lost hide date fields) all work, save moves lead between sections (overdue -> disappears when given a future date). Manual Add Lead dialog validates missing course and missing consent and successfully creates a lead that appears in Visited/All Enquiries. WhatsApp dialog opens with template picker, rendered preview, and Open WhatsApp button. Lead Detail inline follow-up form and timeline render for both roles; admin sees per-update delete button while counsellor does not. Admin dashboard shows counsellor filter + counsellor name on each lead row, and filter reloads scoped lists.

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription to Add Update, WhatsApp and Manual Add dialogs to silence Radix a11y warnings
critical_code_review_comments: FollowupDashboard.jsx is ~296 lines and holds three dialogs; consider splitting AddUpdateDialog, WhatsAppDialog, ManualAddDialog into own files for maintainability.
openWa uses stale tplId when reopening dialog for different leads (regenWa fetches with the newly chosen template id but initial openWa may fire with previous tplId) - acceptable but worth review.
Manual add form validation only toasts errors; consider inline field-level errors for UX.
